notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] At the normal difficulty level, the player can now take three hits instead of two. In addition, when a player is hit by a bullet from an automatic weapon, the period of immortality is slightly increased.
[*] Added a quick restart of the level when the player failed a mission.
[*] Fixed a bug where a player with two pistols could take a clip in his hand by pressing the "Trigger" button on his right hand.
[*] Added a setting for enabling dynamic shadows.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.content: Added support for shooting with the left hand - for left-handers. You can switch the main hand in the settings menu in the game.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Bug fixes:[list]
[*] Fixed bugs when bullet hit the water.
[*] Fixed some audio issues.
[/list]
